# than the LMS route? Instrument: compose/code/p171-cross-block-gate/check_lost_rows.py
# FALSIFIER: "refuted if OpenOLAT is the ONLY such row across all three files -- which would make
#   T216 an isolated omission rather than a cost of the append-only convention, and P170-C
#   unnecessary."
# VERDICT: FALSIFIER FIRED. SIX other repositories were routed by an earlier pass and are absent
#   from the newest routing table. OpenOLAT is not among them only because p170 RESTORED it.
#   T216 is systemic in verticals/solutions.md, and P170-C is necessary.
# T225 - THE FIRST SHAPE OF THIS GATE WAS UNSOUND, and it is recorded because the gate is the
#   deliverable. Attempt 1 took the population to be "every repo on a line that also carries a
#   licence identifier" and reported 372 lost rows across 3 files -- P471, a gate that marks
#   everything controls nothing. The population was wrong, not the threshold: these files carry
#   large CENSUS tables (190+ MCP servers, LTI libraries, QTI players, OneRoster implementations)
#   that no pass ever offered as recommendations. A newest block that does not re-state a 190-row
#   census has lost nothing. Attempt 2 restricts the population to ROUTING tables -- in this KB,
#   the tables headed `need`, `engagement` or `layer`, which answer "what should a client use".
#   372 -> 7, a 98% cut, and the 7 survive reading.
# T226 - SLUG CASE. Attempt 2 reported 7, including `openolat/OpenOLAT` -- which p170 HAD restored,
#   as `OpenOLAT/OpenOLAT`. GitHub owner names are case-insensitive and this KB writes this one
#   both ways in the same file. A case-sensitive slug match reports a restored row as still lost.
#   Normalised with casefold: 7 -> 6. Any future gate keyed on a GitHub slug needs this.
# SCOPE LIMIT, stated rather than smoothed: ACTION JM asked for three files. Only ONE of them has
#   a routing table in this sense. repos/foundations.md and agents/top.md carry verification and
#   census tables (`repo | HEAD | root grant | ...`, `candidate | licence | why it is not a row`)
#   and route nothing directly -- the agent and repo ROUTING function lives in compose/patterns.md,
#   as P170-D, which this gate reads as 80 of 80 rows intact, 0 lost. So the honest answer to
#   "which shelves lost rows" is: the one shelf that routes by need lost 6, and the shelf that
#   routes by stack layer lost 0.
# Each row below is a CALL, per P170-C's spec -- report, never auto-fix. A row may be absent
